scene_description: Beige dining table with a rectangular perforated metal basket containing brown paper napkins near the front edge. A pepper shaker and a salt shaker stand close together immediately behind the basket.

targets.name: metal basket
targets.description: Rectangular silver basket with circular perforations, holding brown paper napkins near the front edge of the beige table, directly in front of the two glass shakers.
nearby_obstacles: Salt and pepper shakers immediately behind the rear basket wall
targets.clearance_notes: Front and short side walls are exposed, with overhead space and access near the table edge. The shakers are close to the rear wall but do not trap the basket.
targets.other_notes: Target is the basket as a container; the napkins inside are annotated separately. No obvious environmental adjustment is needed to access its exposed sides. Width is the long basket side; depth is the shorter side.

targets.name: brown napkin
targets.description: Topmost brown paper napkin lying flat on the stack inside the perforated metal basket, distinct from the separate napkin near the distant plate.
nearby_obstacles: Raised basket walls surrounding the napkin stack
Other napkins directly beneath the target
targets.clearance_notes: Top face is exposed through the open basket. Raised walls restrict lateral access, and the napkin rests directly on other sheets with little separation for picking a single sheet.

candidate_improvements.description: Separate and lift an edge of the top napkin, then place that napkin on a clear part of the table for individual access.

targets.other_notes: Physical blockage is partial and refers to lateral access through the basket walls; overhead access remains open. Thin flexible sheets may be lifted together if not separated. Height remains unknown because the thickness of a single folded napkin cannot be reliably distinguished from the stack. Dimensions refer to the top napkin, not the whole stack or an unfolded sheet.

targets.name: pepper shaker
targets.description: Clear glass shaker containing dark pepper with a perforated silver lid, standing immediately behind the basket beside the white-filled salt shaker; it is left of the salt shaker.
nearby_obstacles: Rear wall of the metal basket in front of its lower body
targets.clearance_notes: Lid and upper body are exposed. Little space separates the two shakers, and the basket obstructs a low approach from the front.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the pepper shaker into open tabletop space, separating it from the salt shaker and the basket.
Move the napkin basket sideways into clear tabletop space to expose the lower front of the target shaker; this improves front access without moving the shaker.

targets.other_notes: Blockage is partial and approach-dependent; the shaker is not enclosed or covered from above.

targets.name: salt shaker
targets.description: Clear glass shaker containing white salt with a perforated silver lid, standing immediately behind the basket beside the dark-filled pepper shaker; it is right of the pepper shaker.
nearby_obstacles: Rear wall of the metal basket in front of its lower body
targets.clearance_notes: Lid and upper body are exposed. The neighboring shaker limits side clearance, and the basket obstructs a low approach from the front.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the salt shaker into open tabletop space, separating it from the pepper shaker and the basket.
Move the napkin basket sideways into clear tabletop space to expose the lower front of the target shaker; this improves front access without moving the shaker.

targets.other_notes: Blockage is partial and approach-dependent; overhead access remains available.
